scope: Buy Us Time (39777) and The Siegebrul (39862): availability, native kill paths, questgiver phases, basic attack targets and outgoing evacuation gate. Code/data only; no client test.
findings: Local addon chain was 38915 -> 39776 -> 39777 -> 39862 -> 42088. Both secondary battle quests therefore opened too late.

All three battle quests now require reward of 38915, point to 42088 and share negative ExclusiveGroup -39776. The existing effective requirement to reward all three before evacuation is preserved without forcing their order.
No objective or kill alias repair needed: native 39777 requires ten credits 96690, including Slinger 96691 KillCredit2=96690. Native 39862 requires one Olgrul 97546 kill.

Existing Jale/Navarrogg field spawns use phase 4104, granted by zone 7503 entry 203 when 38915 is complete or rewarded. Conditions are already correct despite an unrelated stale phase comment. Both starter/ender relations exist. The 22 enemy spawns and active 98..110 scaling are preserved.

Bash 194019 and both Stone Disc versions 196402/197483 have native TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ANY and no duration. FillAISpellInfo classifies them as SELF; the generic combat loop passes this target to CastSpell. A local AggressorAI subclass moves only those scheduled spells to explicit-victim casts for entries 96690/96691/97546. Other template spells, dialogue, melee and assistance stay delegated to AggressorAI.

evidence.native: highmountain-snowblind-parallel-native-2026-10-12.json; TDB735 original objectives, alias and enders plus runtime DB2 attack effects/misc and hashes.
evidence.primary_guide: https://www.wow-pro.com/highmountain-neutral/ (2016 guide: accepts all three before performing their objectives; its caret syntax alone is not evidence for an AND gate).
evidence.gate_basis: Preserve the current server's effective all-three reward requirement. The independent BtWQuests branch graph converges at 42088. This is not a newly invented single-quest shortcut.
evidence.core: QuestData.cpp adds both PrevQuestID and incoming NextQuestID edges; Player::SatisfyQuestPreviousQuest requires all rewards for a negative ExclusiveGroup. Regression exercises that actual production handler.

validation: Test-HighmountainBloodtotem.ps1: all eight reward subsets for evacuation, parallel starter prerequisites, exact ten-credit completion via each native Mightstone entry, Olgrul-only completion, repeated/absent/rewarded exclusions; earlier quest regressions also pass.

Test-HighmountainSnowblindCombat.ps1: extracted production subclass casts only at victim, removes only the overridden generic events, delegates base behavior, delays for existing cast/control/CC, stops without combat/live victim, clears timers on reset.
Test-HighmountainSnowblindParallelNative.py: original TDB records and native attack target/duration contracts pass.
Test-HighmountainSnowblindParallelData.ps1: migration applied twice to temporary tables; branch/gate/alias/phase/scaling/spawn/AI checks, unrelated rows and custom group preserved.
Live data checks pass for this batch and previous Battle Worms / tribe support batches.
Release worldserver and bnetserver built successfully in build-extractors/bin/Release; --version exits successfully. Runtime config, certificates, data and DLLs preserved.

deployment.method: Scoped backups; stopped worldserver; InnoDB transaction and RELEASED updater registration. Server remains stopped.

limits: No claim of in-game verification. Observe questgiver visibility, parallel acceptance, both Mightstone kill paths, Olgrul attacks and the final all-three handoff in a 7.3.5 client.
Inherited special attacks / barricade choreography were not reconstructed. The current change fixes the demonstrated basic attack targeting defect without rewriting other shared combat behavior.

Battle Worms tribe support remains a bounded server reconstruction, with its limits in the separate audit. Naxa 197232 catalog membership alone does not establish its intended cast role; the earlier audit wording was corrected to account for CanAutoCast.
next: Evacuate Snowmane (42088): inspect Red Skymane 106115, Tarvim Daywalker 106153 and Old Nefu 106191 gossip, escape behavior and three independent objective credits. Its prerequisite gate is repaired here; the evacuation interactions themselves are not covered.
